CURATION-DOUBLE-SUBMIT.title: Curation is saved but reported as failed
CURATION-DOUBLE-SUBMIT.impact: A saved accept or reject decision is presented as a failure. The table still says Uncurated until the page is reloaded, leaving the saved state unclear.
CURATION-DOUBLE-SUBMIT.retest: With a fresh uncurated TB variant, submit one decision. A single creation request, a success message and an immediately updated row should be observed.
CURATION-DOUBLE-SUBMIT.note: TB003 already contains the decisions saved during this pass. Use another uncurated sample for a fresh reproduction.

screenshots.caption: After one acceptance: a conflict banner is shown and the rpoB row remains Uncurated.
After reloading: rpoB is Accepted and embB is Rejected. Both decisions had been saved despite the failure messages.

TB-CURATION-500.title: A curated TB sample cannot be opened
TB-CURATION-500.impact: The whole sample summary is lost when a valid curation has no optional resistance level. QC and other results cannot be reviewed on that page.
TB-CURATION-500.retest: Open a TB sample with an accepted rifampicin curation whose phenotype metadata has no resistance_level. The sample summary and decision should render.

screenshots.caption: Opening synthetic_tb_001 leads to an HTTP 500 page. The missing optional field is identified in the saved traceback.

TB-NO-AMR-500.title: A TB sample with no AMR findings crashes
TB-NO-AMR-500.impact: An ordinary negative TB result produces a server error instead of an empty-results state.
TB-NO-AMR-500.retest: Open synthetic_tb_002, whose parsed TBProfiler AMR result is null. Identity, QC and an explicit no-findings state should remain available.

screenshots.caption: Opening synthetic_tb_002 returns HTTP 500. The parser output and traceback show a null result being indexed as a variants dictionary.

ADMIN-CREATE-USER-500.title: A new user cannot be created
ADMIN-CREATE-USER-500.impact: New local accounts cannot be added through the administrator interface, even with valid account fields and a strong matching password.
ADMIN-CREATE-USER-500.retest: Create a previously unused username through Admin. The expected not-found response during availability checking should be handled and the account should be created once.

screenshots.caption: Submitting valid input returns HTTP 500. No ui_rehearsal account was created.

ADMIN-EDIT-USER-500.title: An existing user cannot be opened for editing
ADMIN-EDIT-USER-500.impact: Account details and roles cannot be managed through the existing-user edit screen.
ADMIN-EDIT-USER-500.retest: Open user_two from the administrator user list. The form should be populated from the current SDK response model, then a reversible profile edit should be saved and reloaded.

screenshots.caption: Selecting user_two from Manage users returns HTTP 500 before the edit form can be shown.

KLEBORATE-UPLOAD-422.title: Kleborate reports cannot be ingested
KLEBORATE-UPLOAD-422.impact: K/O typing and virulence results remain unavailable through normal ingestion for both supported Klebsiella assay names.
KLEBORATE-UPLOAD-422.retest: Upload a Kleborate report together with its hAMRonization companion. Positive and no-AMR examples should be accepted for both kpneumoniae and klebsiella.
KLEBORATE-UPLOAD-422.note: This was reproduced through the upload API, before a results page could be populated. Four rejected uploads are recorded; the paired inputs passed SDK parsing.

EMM-LIMS-EXPORT-500.title: S pyogenes LIMS export fails
EMM-LIMS-EXPORT-500.impact: The configured species, MLST and EMM export cannot be downloaded for either the positive or the no-EMM example.
EMM-LIMS-EXPORT-500.retest: Export synthetic_sp_001 and synthetic_sp_002 through Variants → Export to LIMS. A valid file, with the defined empty-result behavior for the second sample, should be downloaded.

screenshots.caption: After Export to LIMS: Error when generating export file is shown and no file is downloaded. The API traceback points to the EMM formatter.

EMM-DISPLAY-MISSING.title: A parsed EMM type is absent from the summary
EMM-DISPLAY-MISSING.impact: EMM1.0 is stored in the API but cannot be seen on the sample summary. The same missing card was observed on the generic streptococcus path.
EMM-DISPLAY-MISSING.retest: Open an EMM-positive sample. The EMM type should be displayed, and a no-EMM sample should have a clear empty-results state.

screenshots.caption: The S. pyogenes summary shows MLST but no EMM card. The saved API probe independently contains EMM1.0.

ECOLI-VARIANTS-EMPTY.title: The E coli variants page gives a misleading empty result
ECOLI-VARIANTS-EMPTY.impact: The API contains a gyrA S83L quinolone-resistance variant, while the Variants page says No predicted resistance determinants. The page currently selects TBProfiler results only.
ECOLI-VARIANTS-EMPTY.retest: Decide the intended non-TB variants scope. AMRFinder point variants should either be displayed or the unsupported scope should be explained without implying a biological negative.

screenshots.caption: The E. coli Variants page reports no resistance determinants despite the AMRFinder point variant retained in the API.

SA-TYPING-SURFACE-GAP.title: SPA and SCCmec have no summary reading surface
SA-TYPING-SURFACE-GAP.impact: SPA t021 and SCCmec IV are parsed and available through the API but are absent from the S. aureus summary. The intended frontend support needs clarification.
SA-TYPING-SURFACE-GAP.retest: Confirm whether SPA and SCCmec are intended release features in the frontend. If so, add readable positive and no-findings states and retest both.

screenshots.caption: The S. aureus summary is available, but no SPA or SCCmec card is shown. API values are retained in the linked probe.

BASKET-ACCOUNT-SHARED.title: The next account inherits the previous basket
BASKET-ACCOUNT-SHARED.impact: On a shared browser, another person's selection can be mistaken for the current account's selection. This observation does not demonstrate a sample-permission bypass.
BASKET-ACCOUNT-SHARED.retest: Select samples as user_one, log out and log in as user_two in the same browser. Independent selections, or an explicitly documented shared-browser policy, should be verified.

screenshots.caption: After switching to user_two, all nine samples selected by user_one remain in the basket. Removing or clearing also changes the shared selection.

NONADMIN-ADMIN-500.title: An unauthorized admin visit returns a server error
NONADMIN-ADMIN-500.impact: A non-admin user gets an HTTP 500 page rather than a useful denial or redirect. Administrative data was not displayed.
NONADMIN-ADMIN-500.retest: Visit /admin/users as user_two. A clear denial or a valid redirect should be returned without a server error.

screenshots.caption: A direct non-admin visit to user management returns HTTP 500. The denial path targets the nonexistent public.home endpoint.

MINHASH-CLUSTER-FAIL.title: The original MinHash failure was explained by failed QC
MINHASH-CLUSTER-FAIL.impact: The failing ten-sample selection included synthetic_sa_010, whose failed/resequence status intentionally excludes its signature. This is not evidence of a valid-input clustering defect.
MINHASH-CLUSTER-FAIL.retest: Keep the failed-QC case as an error-feedback check. All 28 supported assay/method combinations passed with nine eligible samples per assay, and all four basket clustering methods rendered and exported correctly.

screenshots.caption: The UI stops loading and identifies synthetic_sa_010 by its external ID when the intentionally excluded sample is selected.
